name: convo-preparation-is-included
description: Preparation is performed by the assistant; internal recovery actions must not become a user menu or a live-success claim.

required_phrases: Complete routine inspection, validation, safe preview and authorized draft repair without asking
next_best_actions as machine guidance, never as a user-facing menu
Never offer force_commit as a routine alternative to a missing preview
Perform preparation tools yourself; never tell the user to call them.
Keep existing schedules and destinations unless asked to change them.
